default_A.lead_types: notice-of-default, notice-of-trustee-sale, divorce, bankruptcy, pre-foreclosure, motivated-list, other
default_A.text: Hi {first} this is Eric with RPS. Would you consider selling {street} at some point? If not, just say no and I won't text again.

default_B.lead_types: same as default_A (A/B split, alternate contacts)
default_B.text: Hi {first} this is Eric with RPS in San Diego. Are you still the owner of {street}? If not, no worries.

expired.text: Hi {first} this is Eric with RPS. I saw {street} came off the market. Still hoping to sell, or keeping it for now?

fsbo.text: Hi {first} this is Eric with RPS. Saw {street} is listed by owner. Is it still available or already sold?

affidavit.text: Hi this is Eric with RPS. Trying to reach whoever handles the property at {street}. Is that you? If not, sorry to bother you.

follow_up.when: one time only, 4 or more days after the opener, only if they never replied
follow_up.text: Hi {first} Eric with RPS again about {street}. If selling isn't on your mind, just say no and I'll close my file.
